meta.title: A user with no forms resolving a re-evaluation does not crash
gaps: act 1: library case EDGE-AWD-048 needs {{evalFormUuid}}, which setup "closed_rfp_rfq_with_tech_response" does not provide
The required resolve request needs {{rfpTradeId}} and {{evalFormUuid}}, but {{evalFormUuid}} is not an available token and no operation provides it.
